start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:answer-comments-and-messages for my Instagram messages from today." It reads your business facts and reply templates, fills a reply for every new message it can, checks each against your word checks, and hands you the replies to send with the messages no template covered.

lists.label: Reply templates
lists.holds: One canned reply per row and the words in a message that pick it.

values.text: Hi {from}, it is 49 a month and the first week is free. Want the link?
Hi {from}, we answer Monday to Friday, 9 to 5. Ask away and we reply the same day.
Thank you {from}, that means a lot. Tell us what you would like to see next.

alike: saved replies in a help desk

lists.label: Word checks
lists.holds: One rule for every line a person reads; a reply that breaks an On rule is rewritten before it is handed over.

values.says: No hype words in a reply.
because: replies read as a person, not an ad

values.says: Never promise a result or a date the business has not set.
because: a promise in a DM is a promise

lists.label: Business setup checklist
lists.holds: One row per stage of setting the business up; this workflow writes the replies row.

lists.label: Business setup gaps
lists.holds: One row per thing a stage could not do itself: the step, what was left undecided, what the run did and the evidence.

values.undecided: No live tool sends an Instagram direct-message reply.
values.chosen: Handed 3 checked replies to the person to send by hand.
values.evidence: The live catalog has no send tool for Instagram direct messages.

values.chosen: Submitted status needs_login and pulled nothing.

alike: a blockers column on a board

instructions: 1. Make sure record:business-setup:facts exists (workflow:set-up-a-business-on-trillion step write-the-business-facts writes it); channels must contain instagram.
2. Pour the three example reply templates into the saved-replies list you already keep (see pour), or make list:reply-templates from them, then rewrite each reply in your own words.
3. Pour or make list:word-checks the same way, so every reply is checked before you see it (workflow:set-up-your-checks makes the full list).
4. Say "Run workflow:answer-comments-and-messages". The AI pulls the newest 50 messages, picks a template per message, fills and checks each reply.
5. Read the replies it hands back and send each one yourself; answer the messages it lists as not covered, and turn any you answer twice into a new template row.
6. Open list:business-setup-checklist: the replies row says Done or names its gaps in list:business-setup-gaps.

pour.how: Name the list you already keep for the same job and read it with records:read (its fields and row type). Run tool:pour-example-rows-into-my-list with that list as into and one kit list as kit_list: it matches each kit field to one of yours (your map, the same id, the same label, or a name in alike), pours nothing under 80% and names the fields with no home, and otherwise answers the one records:write that adds the example rows beside your own.
